features.title: Daily Progress Report
features.body: Site engineers submit DPRs directly from the mobile app. Track daily work with quantities completed, manpower deployed, and remarks backed by photo evidence.

features.title: Geo-Tagged Documentation
features.body: Every photo captured through SiteFlow carries GPS coordinates, proving that work was completed at a specific location on a specific date. Subcontractors cannot submit bills for work the office cannot independently verify.

faqs.q: How does offline syncing work for field teams?
faqs.a: Field teams can capture DPRs and photos offline from the mobile app; entries sync to the central dashboard once connectivity returns, so site progress is never lost.

faqs.q: Can we integrate existing scheduling tools such as MS Project?
faqs.a: SiteFlow tracks planned vs actual progress against its own schedule; discuss import and integration options with the team so your existing timelines feed the progress dashboard.

faqs.q: What level of access do subcontractors have?
faqs.a: Subcontractors submit geo-tagged progress and evidence through scoped access, while the office retains independent verification of every entry before it links to billing.
